d: Veteran actor Nana Patekar joins the 100th episode of Guest in the Newsroom for a captivating conversation. He reminisces about his illustrious career, sharing anecdotes from his iconic films like Tiranga, Wajood, Prahaar, and Welcome. Nana also openly addresses the Me Too allegations made against him by actress Tanushree Dutta. He delves into his early struggles in the industry and his days in theater. Nana fondly recalls working with Rajkumar in Tiranga and shares several interesting stories from his career. He narrates amusing incidents from his roles in films like Wajood, Prahaar,…
